en.t: By this time the sky had already grown dark.

units.source_text: 槿姬室内，透过灰色包边的帘子，隐约窥见里面张着黑色的帷屏，令人感到凄凉。

en.t: Inside Princess Asagao's room, through curtains edged in gray, one could faintly make out black draped screens within, giving the place a desolate feeling.

units.source_text: 微风飘送出迷人的衣香来，芬芳扑鼻，内室景象又觉美不可言。

en.t: A light breeze carried out the enchanting scent of her robes, fragrant enough to fill the air, and the inner room seemed beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 侍女们认为在廊檐上招待大臣，太不像样，便请他进南厢来坐地，由一个叫作宣旨的侍女代小姐应对。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting thought it far too improper to receive the minister out under the eaves of the gallery, so they invited him into the southern side room to sit, and a lady-in-waiting called Senji answered on the princess's behalf.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣颇不满意，言道：“难道现在还把我当作年轻人，叫我坐在帘外么？

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji was rather displeased and said, "Do you still treat me as a young man even now, making me sit outside the blinds?

units.source_text: 我之企仰姐姐，已积年累月。

en.t: I have looked up to and longed for you, my lady, for many years and months.

units.source_text: 我以为有这点功劳，可蒙允许出入帘帷了呢。”

en.t: I thought that small merit might at least earn me permission to pass in and out beyond the curtains."

units.source_text: 槿姬叫侍女传言答道：“往日之事，全同一梦。

en.t: Princess Asagao had a lady-in-waiting convey her reply: "All that happened in the past is just like a dream.

units.source_text: 如今虽已梦醒，但这世间是否真实可靠，现在我还模糊难辨。

en.t: Although I have now awakened from that dream, I still cannot clearly tell whether this world is truly real and dependable.

units.source_text: 故你有否功劳，容我仔细考虑再定。”

en.t: So as for whether you have earned any merit, allow me to think it over carefully before deciding."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣觉得人世的确无常。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji felt that human life was indeed impermanent.

units.source_text: 细微之事，亦足发人深省。

en.t: Even the smallest matters were enough to make one reflect deeply.
He therefore sent her a poem, saying:
